title: Dead bug

steps.text: Lie on your back with your knees bent over your hips and your arms pointing at the ceiling.
steps.cue: On your back, knees over hips, arms up.

steps.text: Press your lower back gently toward the floor.
steps.cue: Press your lower back gently down.

steps.text: Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor without letting your back arch.
steps.cue: Lower one arm and the opposite leg.

steps.text: Return to the start and switch sides.

mistakes: Letting your lower back lift off the floor.
Holding your breath as you move.
regression: Keep your arms still and lower one foot at a time with the knee bent.
stopIf: Stop if your lower back arches off the floor and you cannot keep it down, or it hurts.

anatomy.why: The belly muscles keep the lower back still while an arm and a leg lower away.
